name: self-test-node-lint-violation
description: WP1 self-test fixture: deliberately failing lint script. Wired into self-test.yml with an inverted assertion (expects this job's result to be 'failure') so the self-test suite proves, on every run, that the reusable workflow's npm-lint step is a real blocking gate — not a swallow — rather than only proving the detection/routing logic for the happy path. This is the fixture that gives the self-test teeth: see the 'assert-negative-fixture-blocks' job in self-test.yml.
